=== literals
tariff "t"
let a = [1200, 2.35, 500 lb, $450, $2.35/mi, 18%, "x", @2026-10-22, @2026-10-22T08:00-05:00, true, false, none]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (list 1200 2.35 500[lb] $450 $2.35/[mi] 18% (text "x") @2026-10-22 @2026-10-22T08:00:00-300m true false none)

=== integer flag on a number with a unit
tariff "t"
let a = [3 pallet, 2.0 h, 1_200 lb]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (list 3[pallet] 2.0[h] 1200[lb])

=== density literal
tariff "t"
let a = 30 lb/ft3
---
tariff "t"
let a = 30[lb/ft3]

=== precedence of arithmetic
tariff "t"
let a = 1 + 2 * 3 - 4 / 5 % 6
---
tariff "t"
let a = (- (+ 1 (* 2 3)) (% (/ 4 5) 6))

=== unary minus binds tighter than multiplication
tariff "t"
let a = -x * -2
---
tariff "t"
let a = (* (neg x) (neg 2))

=== parentheses
tariff "t"
let a = (1 + 2) * ((3))
---
tariff "t"
let a = (* (paren (+ 1 2)) (paren (paren 3)))

=== comparisons
tariff "t"
let a = [x == y, x != y, x < y, x <= y, x > y, x >= y]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (list (== x y) (!= x y) (< x y) (<= x y) (> x y) (>= x y))

=== membership
tariff "t"
let a = rating.date.weekday in [Sat, Sun]
let b = shipment.weight in 500 lb..2_000 lb
let c = x not in xs
---
tariff "t"
let a = (in (. (. rating date) weekday) (list Sat Sun))
let b = (in (. shipment weight) (.. 500[lb] 2000[lb]))
let c = (not in x xs)

=== logic precedence
tariff "t"
let a = not a and b or c and not d
---
tariff "t"
let a = (or (and (not a) b) (and c (not d)))

=== not binds looser than comparison
tariff "t"
let a = not x == y
---
tariff "t"
let a = (not (== x y))

=== coalesce is loosest
tariff "t"
let a = x or y ?? z
---
tariff "t"
let a = (?? (or x y) z)

=== coalesce with fail
tariff "t"
let price = fuel.price ?? fail "No fuel price on {rating.date}"
---
tariff "t"
let price = (?? (. fuel price) (fail (text "No fuel price on " (. rating date))))

=== coalesce chains
tariff "t"
let a = x ?? y ?? 0 lb
---
tariff "t"
let a = (?? (?? x y) 0[lb])

=== ranges
tariff "t"
let a = [1..3, 1..=3, ..500 lb, 2_000 lb.., 1 + 1..2 * 2]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (list (.. 1 3) (..= 1 3) (.. _ 500[lb]) (.. 2000[lb] _) (.. (+ 1 1) (* 2 2)))

=== field access and optional chaining
tariff "t"
let a = shipment.trailerType?.code
let b = lane.origin.zones
---
tariff "t"
let a = (?. (. shipment trailerType) code)
let b = (. (. lane origin) zones)

=== keywords as member names
tariff "t"
let a = x.round()
let b = w.in(cwt)
let c = x.min(y).max(z)
let d = rating.date.weekday
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call (. x round))
let b = (call (. w in) cwt)
let c = (call (. (call (. x min) y) max) z)
let d = (. (. rating date) weekday)

=== in with a quotient unit
tariff "t"
let a = shipment.density.in(lb/ft3)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call (. (. shipment density) in) (/ lb ft3))

=== in with a whole rate unit
tariff "t"
let a = rate.in($/cwt)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call (. rate in) (/ $ cwt))

=== calls with named and positional arguments
tariff "t"
let a = deadhead(empty: 80 mi, rate: rate)
let b = stepPercent(price, peg: fuelPeg, step: $0.05/gal, perStep: 0.5%)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call deadhead empty:80[mi] rate:rate)
let b = (call stepPercent price peg:fuelPeg step:$0.05/[gal] perStep:0.5%)

=== keywords as argument names
tariff "t"
let a = amount.roundUp(to: $5)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call (. amount roundUp) to:$5)

=== trailing comma in arguments
tariff "t"
let a = f(
  1,
  2,
)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call f 1 2)

=== method call on a module
tariff "t"
let a = fuel.stepPercent(price, peg: peg, step: step, perStep: 1%)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call (. fuel stepPercent) price peg:peg step:step perStep:1%)

=== conversions on type names
tariff "t"
let a = Number(i)
let b = Int.parse(text)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call Number i)
let b = (call Int::parse text)

=== enum variants
tariff "t"
let a = Delivery
let b = StopKind.Delivery
let c = StopStatus.New
---
tariff "t"
let a = Delivery
let b = StopKind::Delivery
let c = StopStatus::New

=== codes and constants as values
tariff "t"
let a = DIESEL_BASE * 2
---
tariff "t"
let a = (* DIESEL_BASE 2)

=== index
tariff "t"
let a = tables.Zones[lane.origin.zip3, lane.destination.zip3]
let b = xs[0]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (index (. tables Zones) (. (. lane origin) zip3) (. (. lane destination) zip3))
let b = (index xs 0)

=== table methods
tariff "t"
let a = tables.Zones.cell(lane.origin.zip3, lane.destination.zip3)?.minimum
---
tariff "t"
let a = (?. (call (. (. tables Zones) cell) (. (. lane origin) zip3) (. (. lane destination) zip3)) minimum)

=== lists
tariff "t"
let a = []
let b = [1]
let c = [1, 2, 3,]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (list)
let b = (list 1)
let c = (list 1 2 3)

=== records
tariff "t"
let a = { code: "FSC", amount: $10 }
let b = { a: { b: 1 } }
---
tariff "t"
let a = (record code:(text "FSC") amount:$10)
let b = (record a:(record b:1))

=== record over lines with a trailing comma
tariff "t"
let a = {
  code: "FSC",
  amount: $10,
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (record code:(text "FSC") amount:$10)

=== record with keyword field names
tariff "t"
let a = { in: 1, to: 2 }
---
tariff "t"
let a = (record in:1 to:2)

=== if expression
tariff "t"
let a = if x > 1 { $10 } else { $20 }
---
tariff "t"
let a = (if [(> x 1) => $10] else $20)

=== if expression chain
tariff "t"
let a = if x > 2 { 3 } else if x > 1 { 2 } else { 1 }
---
tariff "t"
let a = (if [(> x 2) => 3] [(> x 1) => 2] else 1)

=== if let expression
tariff "t"
let a = if let w = shipment.weight { w } else { 0 lb }
---
tariff "t"
let a = (if [let w = (. shipment weight) => w] else 0[lb])

=== match expression
tariff "t"
let perCwt = match shipment.weight {
  ..500 lb => $42.00/cwt
  500 lb..2_000 lb => $35.50/cwt
  _ => $22.75/cwt
}
---
tariff "t"
let perCwt = (match (. shipment weight) [(.. _ 500[lb]) => $42.00/[cwt]] [(.. 500[lb] 2000[lb]) => $35.50/[cwt]] [_ => $22.75/[cwt]])

=== match expression with a record body
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  A => { code: "A" }
  _ => { code: "B" }
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [A => (record code:(text "A"))] [_ => (record code:(text "B"))])

=== lambdas
tariff "t"
let a = shipment.stops.count(s => s.kind == Delivery)
let b = xs.sortBy((a, b) => a)
let c = xs.sum(c => c.weight ?? 0 lb)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call (. (. shipment stops) count) (lambda (s) (== (. s kind) Delivery)))
let b = (call (. xs sortBy) (lambda (a b) a))
let c = (call (. xs sum) (lambda (c) (?? (. c weight) 0[lb])))

=== lambda in a named argument
tariff "t"
let a = f(by: x => x.weight)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call f by:(lambda (x) (. x weight)))

=== text with expressions
tariff "t"
let a = "{x} and {y.z} and {f(1, 2)} and {"nested {q}"}"
---
tariff "t"
let a = (text x " and " (. y z) " and " (call f 1 2) " and " (text "nested " q))

=== text with escaped braces
tariff "t"
let a = "{{literal}} {x}"
---
tariff "t"
let a = (text "{literal} " x)

=== temperature unit as a value in a conversion
tariff "t"
let a = shipment.temperature.min?.in(°C)
---
tariff "t"
let a = (call (?. (. (. shipment temperature) min) in) °C)

=== negative quantity
tariff "t"
let a = -5 °C
---
tariff "t"
let a = (neg 5[°C])

=== charge in tests
tariff "t"
test "t" {
  expect charge(FSC) == $10 and total > $0
}
---
tariff "t"
test "t"
  expect (and (== (call charge FSC) $10) (> total $0))

=== chained comparison
tariff "t"
let a = 1 < x < 3
---
tariff "t"
let a = (< (< 1 x) 3)
! syntax 25..26 Comparisons can't be chained; write each one and join them with `and`

=== lambda outside a call
tariff "t"
let a = x => x
---
tariff "t"
let a = (lambda (x) x)
! misplaced 19..25 A lambda like `x => …` can only be passed to a list method, like `stops.count(s => s.appointment)`

=== fail outside a coalesce
tariff "t"
let a = fail "no"
---
tariff "t"
let a = (fail (text "no"))
! misplaced 19..28 `fail` can only be a statement, or follow `??` as in `fuel.price ?? fail "No fuel price"`

=== empty record
tariff "t"
let a = {}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (record)
! syntax 19..21 A record needs at least one field, like `'{' name: value '}'`; an empty list is `[]`

=== block used as a value
tariff "t"
let a = { 1 }
---
tariff "t"
let a = ?
! syntax 19..24 A block of statements can't be used as a value here; a record is written `'{' name: value '}'`

=== if expression without else
tariff "t"
let a = if x { 1 }
---
tariff "t"
let a = (if [x => 1] else ?)
! syntax 19..29 An `if` that gives a value needs an `else` branch

=== record field without a value
tariff "t"
let a = { a: }
---
tariff "t"
let a = (record a:?)
! syntax 24..25 Expected a value after `:`

=== missing comma in a list
tariff "t"
let a = [1 2]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (list 1 2)
! syntax 22..23 Expected `,` or `]`

=== index without keys
tariff "t"
let a = xs[]
---
tariff "t"
let a = (index xs)
! syntax 21..22 Expected at least one key in the brackets

=== interpolation without a value
tariff "t"
let a = "x {} y"
---
tariff "t"
let a = (text "x " ? " y")
! syntax 22..24 Expected a value inside the braces; a literal brace is written twice, `'{{'` or `'}}'`
